answer: Tie each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable seed, a real compute cost no clone can borrow. One honest agent stands on a narrow ledge and forges a single proof, paying once. A farmer must forge a fresh stamp for every account every epoch; a thousand clones owe a thousand grindings, and the power bill rises like an ocean against the farm until the margin that made it worth running is drowned.
